reason: I'm five minutes from Tawfeer and I grab bread and labneh at the dekkene most days, some on tab. Paying $2 a bag to have someone shop for me makes no sense when I already pass these places.
objection: I top up daily for small things, so a $2 fee on every bag is a lot, and the dekkene gives me a tab. Why would I send a list by 2 p.m. and collect at 6 to 8 when I can just stop on my way home?
would_change_my_mind: If the total on my bag was clearly and visibly cheaper than the shelf price at Tawfeer, by more than the fee, on a big monthly stock-up, I might try it once.
